messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Alert: Elevated gateway errors detected. 502/504 spike on prod-gateway-1/2. SLO breach (p95 latency > 2s, error rate 5xx > 1.5%). Auto-pager triggered.
oncall-alice: I’m on it, joining triage. Paging eng-sre-tom and eng-sre-raj.
eng-sre-tom: seeing a growing backlog in the batching scheduler queues, lots of head-of-line blocking. Gateway timeouts correlate with batch processing stalls.
eng-sre-raj: confirmed. Queue depth metric 'batcher.queue.size' spiked from ~200 to ~3200 over 5m. Many batches are stuck waiting on a few long-running contexts.
ops-nina: any customer-facing impact? CS?
customer-success-jay: Customer telemetry shows ~12 requests/min failing for the top 3 customers in EU region (errors 502/504). One customer opened a support ticket. We'll draft a status line.
eng-sre-tom: initial hypothesis: a subset of requests hitting KV-cache population + long KV restore operations are blocking batchers, leading to HOL (head-of-line) and eventual gateway 504s. Possible cascade: stalled KV I/O -> batch not released -> gateway timeout.
platform-maya: good call. Can we snapshot the scheduler stacks?
eng-sre-raj: running quick debug dump:
```
# stack dump snippet from batcher-42
BatchScheduler::processBatch() waiting on KVRestore(id=0x7f8)
KVClient::restore() blocking 18.3s on s3-read
BatchScheduler::dispatch() blocked waiting for lock
```
eng-sre-tom: exact. We have some long S3 reads spiking. Also seeing increased CPU steal on those hosts.
infra-bot: Auto-scaling suggestion: add 4 workers to redwood-dedicated-pool-1.
eng-sre-tom: apply scaling, and in parallel implement routing mitigation: enable bypass-batching for high-priority routes (make them unbatched) to avoid HOL blocking. That should reduce customer visible errors quickly.
deploy-bot: Command to scale: `infra scale pool redwood-dedicated-pool-1 --add 4 --reason "batcher queue surge"`
ops-nina: doing a quick healthcheck, switching canary traffic to regional-fallback-gateway for 10% of traffic to relieve load.
platform-maya: suggestion: temporarily lower max-batch-wait to 10ms for affected pool to shorten latency and reduce batching window. Can we push via config change?
eng-sre-raj: pushing config patch now: `batcher.max_wait_ms=10` to pool 1. Rolling update in progress.
eng-sre-tom: also disabling KV-prefetch for non-critical routes to avoid extra S3 reads.
customer-success-jay: writing a short customer note: "We are seeing intermittent 502/504s in EU; mitigation in progress. We'll update in 30 minutes."
eng-sre-tom: metrics after changes so far: queue depth down to ~700, 5xx rate dropping from 1.6% -> 0.4% for the last 5m. p95 latency improving.
ops-nina: regional-fallback reroute applied, 10% traffic moved. No new large customers reporting errors.
platform-maya: observed tail latency for batch processing improved, but a few worker instances still show high I/O wait. Might be bad disk node causing repeated slow S3 reads.
infra-bot: flagging node ip-10-2-3-45 for replacement.
eng-sre-raj: cordoning and replacing that worker. Drain in progress.
eng-sre-tom: recommend we keep bypass-batching on for 30m and monitor. If stable, roll back to normal batching with updated KV timeout guards.
customer-success-jay: posted incident update to customers and to status.redwood.ai with "partial degraded performance".
eng-sre-raj: logs snippet showing gateway errors mapping to batcher backlog:
```
[2026-03-15T10:11:23Z] gateway-prod: upstream write timeout after 30s -> 504, trace=abcd1234
[2026-03-15T10:11:24Z] batcher-42: emit_event batch_wait_exceeded size=128 wait_ms=32910
[2026-03-15T10:11:30Z] kvclient: s3_read duration=18030ms key=kv-ctx-98
```
oncall-alice: is there any customer data exposure?
eng-sre-tom: no, this looks like availability only. No errors indicate data leakage.
platform-maya: rolling mitigation summary for handoff: 1) added 4 workers to pool 1, 2) set `batcher.max_wait_ms=10` on pool 1, 3) enabled bypass-batching for high-priority routes, 4) cordoned ip-10-2-3-45, 5) disabled KV-prefetch on non-critical routes, 6) regional-fallback reroute at 10%.
eng-sre-raj: current state: errors down to baseline (~0.2%), queue depth ~150. Starting monitoring window.
ops-nina: creating an incident workspace and attaching logs. Will add timeline.
customer-success-jay: CS will send a follow-up in 20m with ETA and mitigation summary.
oncall-alice: preparing handoff to night oncall (eng-sre-raj) in 1h. Leaving these actions: keep bypass enabled, monitor queue_depth, watch for recurring S3 latency on replaced node.
eng-sre-raj: will take first-watch. Will escalate if reappearance.
eng-sre-tom: thanks everyone. We should run a postmortem and add a guard to detect long KV reads earlier and auto-bypass batching when that pattern starts.
platform-maya: agreed. I’ll open the postmortem ticket and assign owners for follow-ups.
eng-sre-raj: quick note for post-incident: look at `batcher.queue.wait_histogram`, `kvclient.s3_read_p95`, and add an alert for batch_wait_exceeded > 30s.
infra-bot: Incident closed for page rotation. Next update scheduled +30m. :white_check_mark:
